notes: 501(c)(3) since 2004; 6,000+ small dogs rehomed. Volunteer- and foster-run, no physical shelter (mailing only). Focuses on small-breed dogs pulled from crowded local shelters and Southern/West-Coast shelters. Fees (2026): puppies <1yr $550, dogs 1-8yr $450, seniors 9+ $325 (+$100 deposit if unfixed); includes microchip, age-appropriate vaccines, spay/neuter. All household members attend the meet & greet.
